Description: [Mystic Mayhem (Weekly)] Enable Mystic Mayhem bosses in Midtown Patrol. Standard workflow: move this file out of Patches/Off/ into Patches/ + restart to turn the event on, move it back + restart to turn it off. Investigated whether the 4 eWETV_Enabled LiveTuning entries (LiveTuningDataMysticMayhem.json / LiveTuningData_01ResetPatrols.json) could replace the restart-toggle - they DON'T, since MetaState-driven population placement (PopulationObject.SpawnByMarker via SpawnScheduler.ScheduleMarkerObject) never checks IsLiveTuningEnabled(), unlike the regular ambient-respawn path. Those LiveTuning entries are left in place anyway (harmless, gives partial respawn-suppression once toggled), but this patch file itself is still the real on/off switch and still needs the restart. Tabled 2026-07-24 as a real engine gap worth a proper fix another day - see the phantom-blacklist-style memory notes
